content.comment_body: Why is it not possible to communicate with the [product_name] using [product_name] software when the [product_name] communication module is also connected to the basis module? Only these three devices are present on this dedicated network.

analysis.insight_summary: User is unable to connect to the basis module with the engineering software when a communication module is attached, suggesting a problem related to network setup or compatibility. The issue arises in a small, isolated environment, pointing to possible shortfalls in device integration or configuration.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects to maintain access to the basis module through the software even with a communication module connected, seeking stable and interference-free communication within a straightforward network configuration.
